blurb: Guests fish for big game fish such as Blue Marlin, Striped Marlin, Spearfish, Wahoo, Dorado, Tuna, and Barracuda. The Mele Kai is a 41-foot USCG licensed sport fishing vessel with expert crew and top fishing gear. Whale watching charters are also offered seasonally to observe humpback whales and other marine wildlife.
